title: The Tests page's environment matrix shows where each case ran and how it went
description: With fixture results where case A passed in Trial and Main but failed Served, and case B only ran in Nightly, the served /api/tests read renders the matrix as the default view: those cells with their ages, 'not run here' in neutral style elsewhere, each category group's pass/fail count, the per-column totals, and 'only failing' leaving case A.
